# Alessandro Caforio {.no-anchor}

::: {.lede}
I work on **demand forecasting** in retail, where the hard part is often making
the data and evaluation trustworthy enough to guide a decision.

Here I use public datasets to test forecasting methods, build the underlying
tools, and show the baselines alongside the results. I also share notebooks
that show how I work through statistical learning and neural networks.
:::

::: {.project-card}
### [Italian electricity demand — forecasting from the ground up](projects/energy-demand/index.qmd)

I built a pipeline for Terna's public electricity load data and tested simple
forecasts on national demand. Across four complete months in 2026, the same
time last week baseline had **1,369 MW MAE**; Terna's published forecast had
**567 MW MAE** on the same 11,520 observations. The project page shows the
method and limits.

::: {.stack}
Python · pandas · time series · data quality
